description: Cactus turns commercial real estate due diligence into a conversation. Pull up your CRE deals and portfolio, review underwriting facts — NOI, rent rolls, cap rates, debt terms — and trace every number back to its source document. Verify what’s supported, flag what isn’t, and get a clean deal overview in seconds. Built for acquisitions teams, analysts, and investors who need answers they can defend.

defaultPrompt: Give me an overview of my commercial real estate portfolio and my most active deals.
Walk through the underwriting facts on my latest deal and flag anything that isn’t verified yet.
Show me the source documents behind the rent and NOI numbers in one of my deals.
